name: Next Please
source:
The supermarket lights are too bright. The checkout beeps are too loud. Your mom said she’d be right back—just one more thing. But the queue moved too fast. Now it’s your turn. The cashier is waiting. The people behind you are waiting. A mountain of groceries sits on the belt, and your pockets are empty. Every second stretches into an eternity. What do you do? What can you do? Your heart is pounding in your ears, louder than everything else. This is fine. Everything is fine.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4156430/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
超市的灯光太亮了。结账的声音太大了。你妈妈说她马上就回来——只是还有一件事。但队列移动得太快了。现在轮到你了。收银员正在等待。后面的人都在等着你呢。腰带上堆积如山的食品杂货，而你的口袋却空空如也。每一秒都延伸为永恒。你做什么工作？你能做什么？你的心在你耳边狂跳，比其他一切都响亮。这很好。一切都很好。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4156430/]Steam[/url]]
